title: Median-of-Means as an Extremal Convex Estimator and a Nonconvex Route to the Trimmed Oracle
abstract: arXiv:2609.01689v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We revisit median-of-means estimation from a deterministic optimization viewpoint and develop a family of block-Lp estimators for robust learning with heavy-tailed and adversarially corrupted data. In a block contamination model with at least a fraction 1 minus epsilon of good blocks, we first show that every convex block M-estimator has worst-case robustness constant at least 1 divided by 1 minus 2 epsilon. This matches the classical median-of-means bound and proves that the trimmed-block oracle constant 1 divided by 1 minus epsilon cannot be attained within the convex class. We then introduce a nonconvex block-Lp family for p between 0 and 1 and derive finite-sample deterministic robustness bounds for all global minimizers. As p decreases from 1 toward 0, these bounds continuously approach the trimmed-block oracle constant. translated_title: 均值中位数作为极值凸估计器与通往截断Oracle的非凸路径
translated_abstract: 我们从确定性优化的视角重新审视均值中位数估计，并发展出一族用于处理重尾及对抗性污染数据稳健学习的块-Lp估计器。在至少有比例1-ε的好块的块污染模型中，我们首先证明每个凸块M-估计器的最坏情况稳健性常数至少为1/(1-2ε)。该结果与经典的均值中位数界相匹配，并证明了截断块Oracle常数1/(1-ε)无法在凸类中达到。随后，我们引入一个p介于0与1之间的非凸块-Lp估计器族，并推导出适用于所有全局最小值的有限样本确定性稳健界。当p从1向0减小时，这些界连续地逼近截断块Oracle常数。在温和的分离条件下，对于足够小的p，该族估计器的全局最小值与Oracle的全局最小值相重合。
tldr: 本文证明所有凸块M-估计器的稳健性常数下界为1/(1-2ε)、因而无法在凸类中达到截断Oracle常数1/(1-ε)，并提出非凸块-Lp估计器族，其稳健界随p趋于0连续逼近该Oracle常数，从而通过非凸途径突破凸估计类的固有稳健性极限。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that every convex block M-estimator has a worst-case robustness constant of at least 1/(1-2ε), making the trimmed-oracle constant 1/(1-ε) unattainable within the convex class, and introduces a nonconvex block-Lp estimator family whose robustness bounds continuously approach the oracle constant as p→0, thereby surpassing the inherent robustness limit of convex estimators via a nonconvex route.
